name: Density
intent: Sets how big the kit controls inside it are: compact = small, default = medium, comfortable = large.
usage: Wrap the app content (or one area) in Density and pass the person's choice, usually from the AppHeader account menu. Controls inside that have no size of their own take it from Density: Button, ButtonGroup, ButtonFilter, DropdownMenu, Input, Select, DatePicker, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch and SegmentedControl use sm, md or lg; Cell and HeaderCell go sm in compact. AppHeader follows it too (bar, search and buttons). A size set on a control always wins. Badges, avatars, modals and text areas keep their own sizes. See contracts/density.json for the full contract.

value.note: compact = sm, default = md, comfortable = lg.

children.note: The page or area it sizes.

useWhen: Applying the person's Density & text size choice to the whole app.
Making one area denser, like a data-heavy table toolbar.
doNot: Do not set size on every control to fake a density. Wrap them in Density.
Do not invent DensityProvider, SizeProvider or a local size context.
Do not size the AppHeader by hand. It follows its density prop, or the surrounding Density.
a11y: Renders nothing of its own. Every size keeps the kit focus ring and a clickable target of at least 28px.
